## Checklist

- [ ] One change, not several.
- [ ] The tests and the lint pass (CONTRIBUTING.md has the commands), and new behaviour has a test.
- [ ] It changes a component, its tests, an example, `bench/` or `docs/`: the hosted platform's client is changed upstream.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] A number stated in a docstring or in the README states how it was measured.
